processor.package: QFN40 5x5 mm, 0.4 mm pitch, 3.3 mm exposed pad (flashless ESP32-C6; LCSC C5364646)
processor.usb: USB Serial/JTAG on GPIO12/13 (pads 18/19) to back contacts 26 (D-) and 24 (D+)
processor.boot: GPIO8 must be high and GPIO9 low for serial download; GPIO9 high for normal SPI boot
processor.spi_routing: All six QSPI link signals and CRESET/CDONE go through the GPIO matrix (pads 6-9, 12, 13, 16, 17); no strapping pin is used. Verify the configuration clock the C6 can drive through the matrix before relying on quad mode.
processor.fpga_reset_default: FPGA_CRESET_N pulled low; all MCU-FPGA links avoid ESP strapping pins, including an ESP-only reset after FPGA configuration
processor.flash: W25Q128JVPIQ 16 MB quad SPI NOR (WSON-8 6x5, LCSC C190862) on SPI0/1 (QIO), powered from the 3.3 V plane; VDD_SPI (pin 23) unconnected

power.budget_status: design target; validate with chosen FPGA image and radio transmit bursts
power.input_bulk: C60 plus C61/C67 reassigned to regulated 3.3 V input
power.core_regulator: TLV75512PDBVR, 3.3 V to 1.2 V; check dissipation against FPGA design current
power.rf_filter: Review C6 supply-filter values against reference design; do not omit RF decoupling
carrier_requirements: No 5 V on any module power or signal contact
Connect every designated supply and ground contact
Do not drive module I/O when its supply is off
Carrier must implement regulated input, transient protection and reset sequencing

mechanics.interface: M.2 Socket 3 M-key mechanical interface with CUSTOM electrical pinout
mechanics.numbering: M.2 positions 1 through 75, omit key positions 59 through 66
mechanics.assembly_side: F.Cu only; B.Cu edge contacts have no paste or placed components
mechanics.carrier_socket_candidate: TE Connectivity 1-2199230-6, M-key, 4.2 mm seating height
mechanics.retention: M2 screw and carrier standoff; edge bevel and notch per connector drawing
mechanics.compatibility: NOT PCIe/NVMe/SATA compatible. Only connect to purpose-built v2 carriers.
release_checks: Confirm board outline, notch, plating and bevel against socket drawing
Confirm final 2242 placement fit, mounting clearance and insertion envelope
Stackup chosen (JLC04081H-3313) and RF feed recalculated; USB pair geometry still to check on this stackup; confirm finished thickness over the fingers
Quote plated fingers and panelization alongside single-side assembly
Check finish lifetime against expected insertion cycles

verification_required: Official C6 QFN32 symbol pin audit including FH8/FH4 common package
Native KiCad netlist comparison against icd-v2-pinout.csv and c6-fpga-link.csv
ERC, DRC with schematic parity, and workspace quality profile
Visual schematic, copper, solder mask, solder paste and 3D review
Firmware C6 target and boot/configuration sequence
Prototype RF match, clock startup, supply transient and thermal checks

sourcing.LQP03TG24NJ02D: L5, 24 nH 0201 for XTAL_P: LCSC number still to assign
sourcing.confirm: Check stock for all parts at order time

layout.layers: F.Cu signal/components, In1 GND, In2 +3.3V plane with a +1.2V island under U2, B.Cu ESP bus and FPGA lanes to the back contacts
layout.contact_field: Front ground contacts each carry a via 1.3 mm above the pad; the back-contact lanes beside them step 0.15 mm aside and re-enter their pads straight. Contact 33 (formerly ground) carries ESP_GPIO4 through the same via.
layout.flash: U4 north-east of U1, rotated so DI/CLK/HOLD fan straight into its south row; WP/DO/CS run up the east side. The flash pin order is mirrored against the C6 SPI pins, so WP and DO cross under CS on B.Cu in the corner above U4 (two vias each).

stackup.name: JLCPCB JLC04081H-3313
stackup.why: M.2 requires 0.8 +/- 0.08 mm; JLCPCB 0.8 mm 4-layer builds are 0.721-0.803 mm nominal with +/- 0.1 mm tolerance, so the best-centred build was chosen
stackup.layers: 35 um Cu / 0.0994 mm 3313 prepreg er 4.1 / In1 GND / 0.5 mm core er 4.48 / In2 +3.3V / 0.0994 mm 3313 / 35 um Cu
stackup.rf_feed: 50 ohm coated CPWG 0.14 mm trace / 0.15 mm gap (JLCPCB calculator 50.4 ohm, field solve 49.9 ohm; docs/rf-feed.json)

card_edge.finish: ENIG with the gold-finger option (JLCPCB plates fingers gold only under ENIG; HASL would tin them)
card_edge.bevel: 30 deg (JLCPCB offers 30/45 only; the M.2 drawing shows 20 deg, confirm socket fit). Copper setback 0.6 mm from the routed edge: JLCPCB quotes ~1.13 mm at 1.6 mm board thickness for 30 deg, scaled to 0.8 mm and rounded up.
card_edge.solder_mask: Finger field fully opened on both sides (window in the J1 footprint); no pour or via inside the window (rule area m2-finger-window).
card_edge.panel: A board or panel with gold fingers must be at least 50 x 50 mm and chamfers need >= 5 x 5 cm, so the 22 x 42 mm card is ordered as a panel with the connector edge on the panel outline; a V-cut may not cross the fingers.

deviations: Eight ground vias sit in the two exposed pads (U1 four, U2 four); the playbook forbids vias under packages but a grounded exposed pad has no other return.
C48/C50 and C39 return to ground through the front pour (no dedicated via fits beside the contact fan / the XTAL_N drop).

VDD_SPI (U1 pin 23) is left unconnected: the flash is powered from the 3.3 V plane (allowed by the datasheet) because pin 23 sits between the flash data pins and its 0.1/1 uF pair would not fit. The flash has 0.1 uF (C68) at pin 8 and C33 (10 uF) on the plane 4 mm away; no 1 uF at the flash.

Decoupling beyond 2 mm: U2 pin 5 (C50 2.9 mm, boxed in by the CRESET/CDONE drops and the pin-4/6 exits), U2 pin 29 (C44 2.9 mm; pins 28/30 exit either side so only one cap fits on the 29/30 pair and it went to the core pin 30), U2 pin 33 (C46 3.7 mm, plane via at the pin), U1 VDDA3P3 pins 2/3 (C35 3.6 mm; the RF match owns the space beside pins 1-3), U1 VDDPST1 pin 5 (C37 2.7 mm, west of the four link columns), U1 VDDPST2 pin 28 (C38 2.4 mm, beyond the GPIO15/TXD/RXD vias at 0.4 mm pitch).
